uplo-data-analytics 1.0.0

- Initial release providing AI-powered data analytics knowledge management.
- Enables search across pipeline documentation, dashboard specs, data governance policies, and reporting standards.
- Offers workflows for metric definition reconciliation, data lineage investigation, and governance documentation discovery.
- Includes structured extraction and specialized tools: search_with_context, search_knowledge, flag_outdated, report_knowledge_gap, and propose_update.
- Designed to help data teams address documentation gaps, ensure data quality, and streamline analytics onboarding.
